Hi Samantha — great to meet yesterday. Sending the short playbook below so your AP team has a deterministic path while we finish portal entitlements. TL;DR: portal preferred for SSO+audit logs; email allowed as a temporary backstop with strict subject and filename convention.

Attached: Redwood onboarding form (redwood_onboarding_form_v2.pdf) and example compact CSV schema.

Required for email backstop (until portal live):
- Subject token: INVOICE|PO:<PO_NUMBER>|ACME (example: "INVOICE|PO:12345|ACME"). The prefix "INVOICE|" signals ingest pipeline, PO: is parsed.
- Filename convention: <ACME-ENTITY>_PO<PO_NUMBER>_<YYYYMMDD>.<ext> (example: ACME-NA_PO12345_20261201.pdf).
- If sending CSV: use compact lineitem CSV with columns: invoice_number, po_number, line_number, sku, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, total_amount. Include UTF-8 without BOM.
- PDF PO stamping: not required if PO appears in filename and subject token; stamping speeds human review for exception cases.
- Max inline attachment size: 25MB. We prefer 1 PDF per invoice; multiple PDFs for split invoices OK if filenames include segment suffixes (e.g., PO12345_part1.pdf).

Security / logging notes:
- Portal (preferred): SAML SSO + audit trail, automatic line-item extraction and idempotency checks.
- Email backstop: please send to ap-backstop@redwood-invoice.com (we will provision a per-supplier mailbox). That address only accepts messages with correct subject token and signed DKIM/SPF; otherwise it's dropped to a human queue.

Operational items for Redwood team (internal):
- Map incoming subject token variants into a canonical token and set up HubSpot webhook for ingestion alerts.
- If a PO isn't matched, deposit into exception queue and generate an ack to sender with a unique exception id.

I pasted a sample compact CSV row below for your CSV team.

Sample CSV row (comma-delimited):
"INV-2026-104",12345,1,SKU-AC-1001,"Cloud credits - December",1,1500.00,0.00,1500.00

I'll loop Vanessa (vendor enablement) and Kimberly (AP operations) on the follow-ups. If you prefer us to set up SFTP instead of the portal temporarily, let us know — we can provision an SFTP account and share key instructions, but that path lacks the automatic audit & SSO features.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Vendor Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-09T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: ACME onboarding — verify ingest rules and token handling

Vanessa / Kimberly,

Quick internal note to capture decisions before I send the final acceptance to Acme:
- Set ap-backstop@redwood-invoice.com as the per-supplier mailbox for Acme.
- Ingest pipeline should accept subject prefixes: "INVOICE|PO:<num>|ACME" and also parse "ACME|PO:<num>" (we need both for supplier variance). Normalize to PO only.
- Filenames with entity and PO are authoritative when present. If subject token present but no filename PO, use subject PO. If multiple PO numbers found, route to exception queue.
- Confirm DKIM validation on incoming mail and reject messages failing SPF/DKIM to avoid spoofing. We should include a human-review fallback with an exception id in the ack.

Questions:
1) For multi-entity suppliers (Acme has NA and EU entities), do we want a strict entity prefix (ACME-NA) or accept a freeform entity field in CSV? My vote: require entity prefix in filename and CSV column to avoid cross-entity posting.
2) For SFTP fallback, do we allow CSV+PDF pairs or only single combined PDFs? If SFTP is requested, we should accept CSV+attachments zipped.

I'll wait for your quick confirmation and then send the final email to Samantha to close the loop.

—Jonas
